title: Change the details on a NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card
summary: You can change the details on your NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card online or by calling 13 77 88.
intro: If you need to change the details on your NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card, you can do this online. Alternatively, please call us on 13 77 88.
what_you_need: Your current and new personal details
Your Seniors Card or Senior Savers Card number
If calling, you will need your current and new personal details.

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to change your details.

faqs.q: How can I change my details on my Seniors Card or Senior Savers Card?
faqs.a: You can change your details online or by calling 13 77 88.

faqs.q: What do I need to change my details online?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, your new personal details, your current and new personal details, and your Seniors Card or Senior Savers Card number.

faqs.q: What are the steps to change my details online?
faqs.a: Select the 'Change online' button, log in or create your MyServiceNSW Account, and follow the prompts to change your details.
